description: OLE-ERROR channels of ADO-level failures: after each of MoveFirst on a closed Recordset, Execute on a closed Connection, Command.Execute with no ActiveConnection, Recordset.Open of a nonexistent table with adCmdTable, Fields.Item out of range, an invalid Execute option value and, as a baseline, a provider failure (bad SQL), read the open Connection's Errors count and entries and the closed Connection's. Asks whether failures raised by ADO itself populate the extended error collection or only the Automation error.
retentionNote: Designed r-oledb-odbc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
